reference: Operator declaration dated 2026-09-03. Points represent one 0.25-degree GFS grid node in each of the three largest Greek wind-capacity regions reported by HWEA/ELETAEN at 31 December 2023: Central Greece 2,293 MW, Peloponnese 639 MW, and Eastern Macedonia-Thrace 534 MW. Weights are those capacities renormalised over the selected regions. This wind-weighted basis is also applied to irradiance and temperature because the v0.9 fetch contract admits one common geography; it is not a demand or solar-capacity weighting. The 2023 vintage predates validation and test data. Primary statistics must be retained with the acceptance evidence.
